outlooks.confidence: Tested on forecasts made 3 days ahead, on days from 17 Jul to 17 Oct: 45% of the days this model flagged did cross the line (11% would by chance), and it flagged 59% of the days that crossed it.
outlooks.details: Our own forecast, made before the period it covers. Forecast daily highs, corrected by 1.0 °C for the difference between the forecast service and the 30-year record, reach this place's 95th percentile for the time of year on 2 days in a row. That line is moved up 0.5 °C for the warming this place's record shows since its middle year. 4 Nov: 27.9 °C against a usual worst of 27.6 °C. 5 Nov: 28 °C against a usual worst of 27.5 °C.
outlooks.evidence: Open-Meteo forecast issued for 2026-11-01, compared with NASA POWER daily records for New Orleans, Louisiana, United States, 1996-2025. Bias measured over 21 shared days.
outlooks.verificationRule: Checked against the daily maximum temperature NASA POWER records for these days once they are available: correct if the line was crossed on at least one day of the window, a false alarm if it was not.
